look_here_first: Decumbent whitish stems, unusually soft long pubescence, distinctly white/silvery lower leaf surfaces, and red to red-pink flowers.

project_inclusion.range_basis: POWO supports Texas nativity at state scale, while FNA describes the species as usually near the Texas coast. No exact project target-zone county is currently locked.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Retained because it is in the approved source pool; label range unresolved and do not count it as confirmed target-zone native.

morphology_keys.comparison_training: Use the very soft long hairs, silvery abaxial surface, decumbent habit, and distribution together; flower color alone is not enough.
